findings.highlight: I can’t quite figure out how to deal with her
findings.governingReading: Shirou frankly finds Rider difficult or uncomfortable to deal with.
findings.explanation: The English changes a stable interpersonal reaction into uncertainty about what procedure to use with her.

findings.evidenceJa: 一人で正座してるだけ
findings.governingReading: Rider alone remains seated formally in seiza while Shirou and Sakura eat.
findings.explanation: The English omits her conspicuously formal kneeling posture from the domestic incongruity.

findings.highlight: I am not interested in how humans consume nutrition
findings.evidenceJa: 人間としての栄養摂取に興味はありません
findings.governingReading: Rider has no interest in taking nourishment as a human does.
findings.explanation: The English makes her object of disinterest the method by which humans eat, rather than human-style nourishment itself.

findings.highlight: your manners do not suit me
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方たちの作法は、私には合いません
findings.governingReading: Rider says their practices or customary way of doing things do not suit her.
findings.explanation: The English turns incompatibility with human dining practice into a criticism framed around their manners.

findings.highlight: This is your first time eating, right?
findings.evidenceJa: ご飯食べるの初めてでしょ？
findings.governingReading: Sakura assumes this is Rider’s first experience eating an ordinary prepared meal in this human domestic context.
findings.explanation: The English literally implies that Rider has never eaten anything before.

findings.highlight: You’re going to be doing a lot of things for me
findings.evidenceJa: これからライダーにはお世話になる
findings.governingReading: Sakura says they will be relying on or indebted to Rider from now on.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the household’s anticipated help to Rider performing many tasks personally for Sakura.

findings.highlight: Rider watches Sakura as she happily starts cooking
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーは居間から、嬉しそうにはしゃぐ桜の姿を見守っていた
findings.governingReading: From the living room, Rider watches over Sakura as Sakura cheerfully bustles with excitement.
findings.explanation: The English omits Rider’s separate position and protective watching frame, and reduces Sakura’s sustained animation to beginning the cooking.
